neighbours.label: The closing piece of 'Last Supper' ('per') and of double-barrelled '-Jones' surnames ('ones'): a list, I found no shared pattern
fire: Among the paintings in the refectory is the Last Supper, finished around 1498.
Art students in Milan queue for hours to see Leonardo's Last Supper every summer.
Monks gathered in the chapel beneath a fresco of the Last Supper on the north wall.
The film restages the Last Supper with the actors seated along one table.
The sermons of Martyn Lloyd-Jones were collected by his family.
Sophie Rhys-Jones married Prince Edward in Windsor in 1999.
Actress Catherine Zeta-Jones won an Oscar for her role in the musical.
The historian Tudor-Jones published a new study of the Welsh coalfields.
quiet: Among the paintings in the refectory is a fresco of the harvest, finished around 1498.
Art students in Milan queue for hours to see Leonardo's drawings every summer.
Monks gathered in the hall for a simple supper of bread after the service.
The film restages the Lord's Prayer with the actors seated along one table.
The sermons of Martyn Jones were collected by his family.
Sophie Jones married her fiancé in Windsor in 1999.
Actress Catherine Walsh won an Oscar for her role in the musical.
The historian Tudor Davies published a new study of the Welsh coalfields.

notes: Card: 'per' x4 in Last Supper, 'ones' in Spence-Jones. Probe: Last Supper 1.19, Spence-Jones 0.78, Burne-Jones 0.38; Lord's Supper 0.06, Dow Jones 0.01. A shared 'final piece of a fixed name' pattern failed in probes: Mona Lisa, Rolls-Royce, Coca-Cola, Holy Grail all stayed under 0.03. Bab el Bahar 'ar' 1.0 and 'Save the Date' 0.55 are not covered. List label, kept as a list.
